test_title: Delhi Police Constable (Executive) 2023 - Reasoning (Held on: 23 Nov, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Which figure should replace the question mark (?) if the series were to be continued?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bf520ef2b9bd5bfa59c1e16798992123ef271f71731190c562880902f97f0b07.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

1) First box series →

No change in the 2nd and 4th elements from the left.

The rest of the elements are replaced by new element.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ceb737f7e865d6e695876aa3d95c47097ab288ed19ed8d1ac7e6bd1b38622acd.png] 

2) Second box series → 

The elements at the corners interchange positions.

The rest of the elements shift anticlockwise.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e2a8b25e07b2c81d97829c7d60b22842a52751b6ef80d8a859f067d5fa3e5e59.png] 

Thus, the final series is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/548faff2feb6a7a4d60c2c99df563ae1462c2b48d6b635e7ac5b087289c6ea4e.png] 

Hence, "Option 3" is the correct answer.
